questions.title: 避免一对多连接用于存在判断
questions.context: 使用课程中小型客户、订单数据练习避免一对多连接用于存在判断。教学表中的金额以模拟元为单位，不使用企业库的整数分口径。
questions.requirements:
返回至少有一笔销售额>=700的订单的客户编号，每人一次，按编号升序；需求为存在性筛选而非所有订单明细。
输出列名称及顺序：customer_id。按题设排序；参考排序键：c.customer_id。 未指定舍入时保留原计算精度；NULL、零、空字符串不同。

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id AND o.sales>=700) ORDER BY c.customer_id
referenceSolutions.sqliteSql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id AND o.sales>=700) ORDER BY c.customer_id

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id AND NOT (o.sales<700)) ORDER BY c.customer_id
referenceSolutions.sqliteSql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id AND NOT (o.sales<700)) ORDER BY c.customer_id
referenceSolutions.explanation: 用反向比较并取 NOT 表达相同三值逻辑。
